kind: Read-only completeness audit of retained Stats NZ and held-queue evidence

unresolved.reason: The dated 2018 original workbook Table 8 D34 reports 8,300 hectares of new exotic forest area for the year to 31 March 2018. This supports the retained 8,293 only at the workbook precision, not all reported digits.
unresolved.required_to_close: Dated original exact-precision 2018 forestry export and its table metadata.

unresolved.reason: Original 2024 final workbook Table 9 D29 reports 9,520 hectares of apples at 30 June 2024; retained target is 9,522. Agreement at published workbook precision is not exact verification.
unresolved.required_to_close: Exact-precision 2024 apple-area export with national dimension, coverage and revision vintage.

unresolved.reason: Dated 2025 final release graph reports 23,252,000 sheep at 30 June 2025; retained target is 23,252,463. Only rounded agreement is supported.
unresolved.required_to_close: Exact-precision final 2025 total sheep official table/export.

unresolved.reason: Dated June-2025 fiscal release provides ADE access and metadata, but no independently presented exact 8,199 cell in the acquired publication. Its 11 September 2026 notice discontinues fiscal releases.
unresolved.required_to_close: Dated official total-sentenced-prisoners fiscal 2024/25 table/export, with counting/rounding semantics. Do not substitute calendar year or quarterly stock.

unresolved.reason: Retained 202606 target is 1,391. Original June-2026 release separately presents 1,419 for median weekly wage/salary earnings. The exact ADE table population/measure/vintage has not been reconciled; no defect or replacement value is asserted.
unresolved.required_to_close: Exact INC_INC_001 table metadata and original dated 202606 cell resolving earnings population and apparent headline difference.

unresolved.reason: Official income metadata establishes the household age exclusion and June-quarter weekly snapshot, but acquired publication has no household 2,438 cell. Individual income statistics cannot certify this household estimate.
unresolved.required_to_close: Exact dated INC_INC_011 household table/export for 202606, total LGR/HHTYPE and MED_INC_ALL_SOUR; confirm household aggregation/basis and revision status.

unresolved.reason: Dated June-2025 fiscal release links ADE but does not independently present exact 50,741 adult convicted count. Fiscal releases discontinued by notice dated 11 September 2026.
unresolved.required_to_close: Dated fiscal 2024/25 adult convictions exact total, counting scope/rounding; not calendar-year, charges or prosecutions.

unresolved.reason: Dated March-2024 annual LEED release states person-level March-year statistics and links ADE; no exact 4,091,334 total people with taxable income cell appears in acquired public release.
unresolved.required_to_close: Dated March-year 2024 IZ/AZ/XZ/RZ official export and population/tax-source definitions.

unresolved.reason: Dated March-2024 annual LEED release links ADE; no independent 57,610 annual median-earnings cell appears. Taxable income population and total earnings must be distinguished.
unresolved.required_to_close: Dated 2024 total-earnings median exact export with income-source scope and tax-year convention.

unresolved.reason: Dated June-2025 quarterly LEED release links ADE and Infoshare. It has no independently presented exact 18,100 full-quarter-job median earnings cell. Jobs are not people and full-quarter jobs are not all/new-hire jobs.
unresolved.required_to_close: Exact 202506 full-quarter jobs MEDIAN_EARN export with gross/tax/coverage and quarter convention.

unresolved.reason: 2024-base original labour-force projection workbook Table 1 E13 gives median 2026 value 3,144 thousand. Retained 3,144,100 cannot be verified to the extra hundred from this rounded table.
unresolved.required_to_close: Exact-precision P50, SEX3, total ages 2026 official export; projection not observed workforce or employment.

unresolved.reason: Original 2018-base household workbook presents B living-arrangement-rate scenarios; target selects MEDIUMA at 2028 with 2,087,100. Medium B 2,029 thousand is a different scenario and is not comparable.
unresolved.required_to_close: Exact Medium A 2028 household projection export, base and A-assumption definitions. Do not switch to recommended Medium B silently.
